literal: When I look, she looks at the ground; when I do not look, she looks and gently smiles.
translation: When I look at her, she looks down at the ground; when I look away, she looks at me and smiles gently.
modern: நான் அவளைப் பார்க்கும் பொழுது அவள் நிலத்தைப் பார்க்கிறாள்; நான் பார்க்காத பொழுது அவள் என்னைப் பார்த்து மெதுவாகச் சிரிக்கிறாள்.
explanation: This couplet beautifully captures the shy, unspoken signs of love between a young woman and her lover. When the lover looks directly at her, she modestly casts her eyes down toward the ground to avoid direct eye contact. However, the moment he looks away, she seizes the opportunity to gaze at him and softly smiles to herself. These subtle, alternating gestures of looking down and smiling reveal her hidden affection and interest without her having to say a single word.
